title: Noun Gender
intro: In Russian, every noun has a grammatical gender: masculine (мужской род), feminine (женский род), or neuter (средний род). Unlike English, the gender of a noun affects how adjectives, pronouns, and verbs agree with it. Learning to identify gender by word endings is essential for building correct Russian sentences.
rules: Masculine nouns typically end in a consonant or -й: стол (table), музей (museum), словарь (dictionary).
Feminine nouns typically end in -а or -я: книга (book), неделя (week), or soft sign -ь: ночь (night).
Neuter nouns end in -о or -е: окно (window), море (sea), or -мя: время (time).
Some nouns ending in -ь are masculine (словарь, день) - these must be memorized as exceptions.

items.promptEnglish: What is the gender of the word 'стол'?
items.hint: Look at the ending - what letter does it end with?
items.explanation: Стол ends in a consonant (л), so it is masculine.

items.promptEnglish: What is the gender of the word 'книга'?
items.hint: Words ending in -а are usually feminine
items.explanation: Книга ends in -а, so it is feminine.

items.promptEnglish: What is the gender of the word 'окно'?
items.explanation: Окно ends in -о, so it is neuter.

items.promptEnglish: What is the gender of the word 'музей'?
items.hint: Words ending in -й are usually masculine
items.explanation: Музей ends in -й, so it is masculine.

items.promptEnglish: What is the gender of the word 'неделя'?
items.hint: Words ending in -я are usually feminine
items.explanation: Неделя ends in -я, so it is feminine.

items.promptEnglish: What is the gender of the word 'море'?
items.explanation: Море ends in -е, so it is neuter.

minimalPairs.context: _____ ends in -а, so it is feminine.
minimalPairs.explanation: Книга ends in -а (feminine ending). Стол ends in a consonant (masculine ending).

minimalPairs.context: _____ ends in a consonant, so it is masculine.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Which word ends in a consonant?
minimalPairs.explanation: Дом ends in a consonant м (masculine). Школа ends in -а (feminine).

minimalPairs.context: _____ ends in -о, so it is neuter.
minimalPairs.explanation: Молоко ends in -о (neuter ending). Музей ends in -й (masculine).
